purpose: Predeclared L8 acceptance set, frozen before rule-language improvements. Run all ten against one frozen engine version; retain every result and failure. Adapted or reused artifacts do not count as success for the original proposal.
successCriteria: A fresh real Codex run produces literal source for the original request
Schema and bounded compiler accept it
Observable effect, deterministic replay, rollback and serialization checks pass
Browser gameplay demonstrates the intended effect without a silent substitution

proposals.text: Give the courier moon gravity so jumps float farther.
Let the courier jump a second time in midair before landing.
Holding interact makes the courier a giant; releasing it returns them to normal size.
A gust of wind pushes every movable crate to the right while it is near a lantern.
Movable crates near the courier move in slow motion, then return to normal speed farther away.
When the ember is dropped, let it bounce like a rubber ball until picked up again.
Every time the courier lands, create a temporary stepping platform beside them.
The faster the courier is running, the stronger their next jump becomes.
Touching a crate makes it bouncy for three seconds.
A still prop’s shadow becomes a solid bridge.
